## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 06.08.2026 - 16.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _13799432478_, 15.09.2026, 4/5: "I've used this app for over a year and got my friends on it too. Giving it 4 stars though bc they keep doing movie promos. The monthly themed adventures used to be creative and fun; now they're just month-long ads. If they do another one this year I'll probably cancel my subscription."
            2. _mysticalgamer666_, 06.08.2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
            3. _I rather not tell my name_, 16.09.2026, 5/5: "Fun game not too expensive for finch plus you can also get a lot of stuff for free if you log in everyday budget friendly and overall just a cool game that helps you get motivated"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Werbedruck** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Werbedruck.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen werbedruck.
      Review-Fenster: 10.09.2026 - 10.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer spüren Werbedruck. Das signalisiert Monetarisierungsreibung und eine Öffnung für einen saubereren Wettbewerber.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _spudd122_, 10.09.2026, 4/5: "I’ve really loved this app for over 2 years now. It’s been helpful for building good habits and staying on top of self-care and mental health. However, the month long events turning into a month long advertisement for an upcoming movie every few months is getting annoying and old quick. I understand this app is free, but forcing month long ads on your customers shouldn’t be the way to pay for it. Ads annoy people and they’ll stop using your product to avoid them."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 28.05.2026 - 13.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, 28.05.2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _epicinsomniac_, 13.08.2026, 5/5: "I’ve just moved into my own place and I have a whole lot of mental issues that tend to get in the way of me hardly looking after myself. I downloaded this when I moved into my own place a few days ago and so far, I’m checking it every day, knocking off goals and getting to actually do more things for myself than I ever have before while also playing with my pet on here. I already love it even though I was truly sceptical at first."
            3. _Fliv Spencer_, 03.06.2026, 5/5: "I love this app so much. I’m on the edge of crying because they made all the pride items free for pride month. This is so fccking cute and supportive, I love it so much. It is very rare that you find an app this supportive which even lets you change everyone’s pronouns and celebrates everyone. Using the app together with friends works so well and helped so much with feeling good about yourself. The animations are incredibly cute and the app works entirely without ads and bugs, there has never been any problem with the app for me!! Thanks so much ❤️❤️❤️🌈🏳️‍⚧️"
<!--/ir-theme-->
